  • Constructor Details

    • Inventory

      public Inventory(String inventoryItemName, String inventoryCategory, String inventoryUnit, int inventoryQuantity)
      Creates a new inventory item with its details, if the ID is not set here because it is given by the database when the item is saved.
      Parameters:
      inventoryItemName - the name of the item e.g. Wheat
      inventoryCategory - the category of th item belongs to e.g. Seeds
      inventoryUnit - the unit the item is measured in e.g. Packets
      inventoryQuantity - how many items stored e.g. 54
